name: Contracted Harvest
summary: Friendly Blades for Hire and Kabal units' ranged attacks gain Sustained Hits 1 against non-Monster, non-Vehicle targets. Exclusive Kabal-tagged detachment.

name: Murderous Agenda
summary: Pick one Contract at the start of the game targeting an enemy unit type; Kabal and Blades for Hire attacks against it gain Precision, Sustained Hits 1, or Lethal Hits by Contract. Destroying the Contract unit completes it for 3 Pain tokens.

name: Callous Competition
summary: Drukhari and Harlequins alternate 'winning the wager' by scoring kills; the winning side re-rolls Hit rolls of 1, the losing side also re-rolls Wound rolls of 1. Lets Harlequins join, points-capped by battle size; they cannot be Warlord.

name: Darkest Artifice
summary: Attacks against friendly Cronos or Talos units from a higher-Strength attacker get -1 to wound. Exclusive Covens-tagged detachment.
